claims.statement: In the explicitly enumerated family of a root with one to six centers, each center carrying at least one pendant leaf, for n=2p+4 and p=10..13, the only eligible tree is the p=10 branch profile (2,3,3,3,3,3); its 17 favorable-leaf summands are all negative and its full sum is -122805.
claims.scope: Exact bounded family check only: sorted positive branch leaf counts m_1<=...<=m_c, 1<=c<=6, sum m_i=2p+3-c, p=10..13. It does not cover all trees of cover number at most six and does not resolve any universal shell or aggregate claim.
claims.reason: Exact graph-recursive independence counts and complete partition generation establish this bounded result. It recovers a cover-threshold obstruction but gives neither a pointwise-sign counterexample nor a positive aggregate, and it omits general low-cover skeletons; the universal questions remain unresolved.

limitations: The exhaustive boundary is only the stated root-and-pendant-arms family, not all ordinary trees with vertex-cover number at most six.
The computation does not prove a general low-cover classification, a pointwise third-shell theorem, or the primary selected aggregate.
No primary-literature theorem was imported or applied.
